description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +50000], [Fire Ability Quick Cast (15s)], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Clive] to the user
Zenith Mode: Clive: En-Fire Damage +20%, Dualcast Fire, Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability, +1500 max HP, Astra, and replaces Rising Flames with Rising Flames+ and Ignition with Ignition+

description.name: Zenith Mode: Clive
description.text: Increases [Fire Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, Hero Abilities have zero hone cost, maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Rising Flames+
description.text: Seven single attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Ignition+
description.text: Four single attacks (1.10 each), grants [Fire Ability Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Fire Ability Quick Cast (15s)
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Fire abilities

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
